title: Elf Bar ElfLiq x Crystal Blueberry Sour Raspberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid - 20mg
description: Elfliq x Crystal Blueberry Sour Raspberry by Elf Bar offers a revitalised take on a legendary flavour profile. As part of the special edition Elfliq Crystal series, this e-liquid refines the classic recipe to deliver a sharper, more vibrant taste experience. The profile opens with the sweet, jammy notes of ripe blueberries, providing a rich fruit foundation. This is immediately cut through by the zingy, electric tang of sour raspberries on the exhale, creating a perfectly balanced sweet-and-sour vape. Mixed with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for optimal performance in low-powered starter kits and refillable pod devices. The 50/50 blend ensures excellent flavour clarity and consistent wicking. Available in a 20mg nicotine strength, the salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction, delivering a premium vaping experience in a sustainable 10ml bottle.
